t: İstikbal - Wikipedia
s: August 19, 2024 - İstikbal Furniture S.A. (Turkish: İstikbal Mobilya A.Ş) is a Turkish furniture retailer that was founded by Hacı Boydak. In 2016, Boydak Holding was found affiliated with FETÖ, and the company was seized by SDIF (TMSF). Istikbal was founded in 1957 in a small carpenter's workshop in Kayseri.
